[[File:Panteer_crown.png|thumb|right|200px|The Panteer crown]]
The '''Panteer crown''' was the traditional symbolic form of headgear that was worn by the monarch of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], before the assassination of the last Panteer queen, [[Silara Panteer|Silara]], and break of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

When it was lost, Sir [[Deris Panteer]], a dying Queensguard, asked visiting servants of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to recover the crown from the wreckage of Queen Silara's transport in the [[Glarus Valley]]. Locating it near near an escape pod not far from the crash site, the Imperial servants brought it to Captain [[Lieber]] at the Panteer mountain hideaway in the valley.<ref name="The Crown">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|The Head That Wears the Crown|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]}}</ref>
